sensor: seca CT331 (custo cardio 300 BT), USB acquisition
context: resting 12-lead recording (about 10 minutes) of a person with a cardiac pacemaker; every QRS is preceded by a ventricular pacing spike
units: ADC counts; multiply by uv_per_count for microvolts
filtering: none (native samples as decoded from the device stream)
time_reference: seconds / samples from the start of the recording; no wall-clock time is included

window.note: only this window of the recording is published (the figure's 2.95 s plus 0.5 s margin each side); the full recording is not included
